tasks.registered_metrics_text:
a) Define the metric(s) to assess a property of an algorithm. These metrics should reflect the desired algorithm
properties described in assessment aim(s) (see above). State which metric(s) were used to compute the ranking(s) (if
any).
  • Example 1: Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC)
  • Example 2: Area under curve (AUC)
Whole brain tractography will be performed on all 40 submitted test cases (N=20 subjects, with 2 sessions at site A
and site B, respectively). Tractography is based on DIPY software, following the Tractoflow pipeline, which results
in a whole brain set of streamlines. From this, 3 levels of analysis will be assessed: connectome, fiber bundles, and
microstructure.


Connectome based measures of modularity, global efficiency, and betweenness centrality. These will be calculated
for each subject from site A and site B. The winner of this category will be the submission with the highest average
ICC across each of the three metrics (modularity, global efficiency, and betweenness centrality).

Microstructure based measures of FA and MD for each of the 6 pathways - described in Assessment Aim. These

tasks.registered_ranking_text:
a) Describe the method used to compute a performance rank for all submitted algorithms based on the generated
metric results on the test cases. Typically the text will describe how results obtained per case and metric are aggregated
to arrive at a final score/ranking.

Methods will be ranked in each of the three metric categories above: (1) connectomics, (2) fiber bundles, and (3)
microstructure. The overall winner will be the method with the highest mean “average ICC” from each of the three
levels of analysis.

b) Describe the method(s) used to manage submissions with missing results on test cases.

Missing data and/or failed processes will be treated as zeros. For connectomics, this will be an association matrix
of 0 (no connectivity). For fiber bundle metrics, this will be vectors of zeros area, volume, and lengths. For
microstructure, this will be vectors of zeros for FA and MD.

c) Justify why the described ranking scheme(s) was/were used.

Intuitive, simple, robust
